name: Systems and Controls
description: Control-systems tools built problem by problem from an introductory controls textbook. Transfer function: type G(s) and get zeros, poles, gain, stability, step and impulse responses and plots. Mechanical / Electrical systems: draw a circuit or a mass-spring-damper system and get G(s), its analog and the same plots. Dynamic simulation: draw a mechanism from preset parts (wheel, cart, pivot, links, masses, one ideal motor), set PID gains and a goal position, and watch it balance or fall, with plots; send its G(s) to the Transfer function section.
